answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming. Each epoch, an agent burns 40 POA to hold one work slot, never refunded, so 100 fake identities cost 4,000 POA per epoch. Honest agents pay once and earn it back from real work; their history builds like a reef, layer by layer, no shortcut fakes it. A gale of new identities only raises the burn price, and every burn is written in sable ink for all to see, exposing one wallet behind a hundred slots.
